text: This solution, USAID’s Tayar—Improved Disaster Risk Management Project (Tayar Nepal) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in Nepal between National Disaster and Risk Reduction Management Agency (NDRRMA), United States Agency for International Development (USAID), World Vision International Nepal (WVI), DAI, Thulo.Com, and EMERGE. The program was implemented in 2019 and focuses on collaboration, raising awareness, and leveraging tech.
